title: This ghost was fired from haunting

lines.tts: [spooky, playful] This ghost was so bad at haunting... he got fired.
lines.text: This ghost was so bad at haunting... he got fired.

lines.tts: [dry] Nobody moved out. The mansion got five stars... for 'cozy vibes.'
lines.text: Nobody moved out. The mansion got five stars... for 'cozy vibes.'

lines.tts: [building] So Boris asked one question: who actually WANTS to be scared?
lines.text: So Boris asked one question: who actually WANTS to be scared?

lines.tts: Teenagers. On a Friday night. Who would pay for it.
lines.text: Teenagers. On a Friday night. Who would pay for it.

lines.tts: [triumphant] So he turned the mansion into a haunted escape room.
lines.text: So he turned the mansion into a haunted escape room.

lines.tts: Same ghost. Same boo. New customer. Sold out every weekend.
lines.text: Same ghost. Same boo. New customer. Sold out every weekend.

lines.tts: That's repositioning. If it's not selling, maybe you're selling it to the wrong people.
lines.text: That's repositioning. If it's not selling, maybe you're selling it to the wrong people.

lines.tts: [breathless, terrified then delighted] That was the scariest thing EVER! ...Five stars.
lines.text: That was the scariest thing EVER! ...Five stars.
